title: Admin: asset create/edit form
interface: Extends base.html. Form POST to request.path with fields asset_tag, type (select from types, selected asset.type when editing), brand, model, serial_number, purchase_date (type=date), price (number step 0.01), notes (textarea); prefilled from `asset` when given; shows `error` in a div.flash.error when set. Variables: asset (dict or None), types, error. Czech.

uses.base: templates/base.html: Jinja layout with blocks title and content; header nav (Moje zařízení '/', for admins: /admin/assets, /admin/handovers, /admin/employees, /admin/audit), current user e-mail and a logout form POST /auth/logout; flashed messages via get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true); links /static/style.css
